title: Sheet Music Practice Backlog
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forscore:practice practiced="no"
| stats count as unpracticed_pieces, max(days_in_library) as max_days_in_library by folder_name
| sort - unpracticed_pieces
description: Shows how many pieces are sitting in the library without recent practice time.
value: A visible backlog keeps music collection growth honest and helps choose the next pages to actually work on.
implementation: Export or tag forScore items with whether they were practiced recently and summarize the backlog by folder.
visualization: Table of folders with unpracticed piece count and max age.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks which sheet-music piles are growing faster than they are being practiced.
